name: Elastic gusset
summary: A side panel of rubber webbing set into the shaft of a boot, so that the boot slips on without laces or buttons.
how: Set a panel of rubber webbing, 4 to 6 cm wide, into each side of the shaft.
Cover the seam with a binding in matching cloth or leather.
Add a pull tab at the top of the back seam.

origin.note: Joseph Sparkes Hall makes elastic-sided boots, and Queen Victoria wears them.

adoptions.via: The elastic-sided boot enters the mass market, and the gusset becomes a mark of the Victorian boot.
